description: The JSON transport of core 18.4 (spec revision v1.2). requests: a request body (body, or body_hex for bytes that are not UTF-8) and its conversion: cbor_hex, the exact canonical CBOR wrapper the server then runs, or the refusal of the JSON stage (ErrMalformed, ErrWrongType; 400); cbor_wrapper names the sentinel the CBOR wrapper decoding then gives. media_types: JT1 ('json', 'cbor' or 415). accept: JT2 for a GET. responses: the JSON object a server renders for a CBOR response (compared as JSON values, member order and whitespace free), or the 500 of JT8. limits and check_order: JT6.

check_order.description: A JSON body one byte above the authorize JSON limit that also has an unknown member: 413 in JSON (size first); its CBOR twin is 413 as well.
A well-formed JSON authorize body within the JSON limit whose converted wrapper is above 67771 bytes: 413 after conversion (JT6).
As the previous one with an unknown member: 400 ErrMalformed in JSON (JSON decoding before the CBOR size), where the CBOR request with an unknown key is 413.
